entries.title: Your First Project
entries.subtitle: Create and process your first manga in 5 minutes.

steps.title: Drag your images to the Dashboard
steps.content: Select or drag RAW manga images directly into the central Dashboard area. Supported formats: PNG, JPG, WEBP, AVIF, and TIFF.
steps.tip: You can drag entire folders - KOMA will import all images recursively.

steps.title: Organize the page order
steps.content: Images appear in the left sidebar list. Drag to reorder or use the auto-sort button to sort by filename.

steps.title: Select the AIO Pipeline
steps.content: Click the AIO lightning bolt icon in the top bar. This activates the "All-In-One" pipeline that detects text, translates, cleans, and applies typography automatically.

steps.title: Configure Languages
steps.content: Select the source language (e.g. Japanese) and the target language (e.g. English). The system will use the appropriate translation model.
steps.tip: For Korean manhwa, select "Korean" as source for better detection results.

steps.title: Start Processing
steps.content: Click "Process All" or use Ctrl+Shift+Enter. A progress bar shows each step: Detection -> Translation -> Cleaning -> Typography.

steps.title: Review the processed pages
steps.content: Navigate pages in the left panel. Compare original vs. processed using the toggle button (shortcut: Tab).

steps.title: Export the final result
steps.content: Click Download (down arrow icon) in the top toolbar. Choose format (individual PNG, ZIP bundle, or local folder) and output quality.
steps.tip: Use "Web Optimized" for WEBP output with reduced file size ideal for online reading.

entries.title: Interface Tour
entries.subtitle: Explore all panels and areas of the interface.

steps.title: Top Bar
steps.content: Contains: KOMA logo, mode selector (AIO, Translator, Cleaner, etc.), quick actions (download, settings), and user profile menu.

steps.title: Left Sidebar
steps.content: Lists pages in the current project. Shows thumbnails, processing status (colored indicators), and supports drag-and-drop reordering.

steps.title: Central Stage
steps.content: Displays the current page at high resolution. Supports zoom (scroll), pan (click-drag), and detected text-box overlays.

steps.title: Right Sidebar (Tools Panel)
steps.content: Contextual tools that change based on the active mode. E.g. in Translator mode, shows detected texts and translation fields.

steps.title: What is AIO?
steps.content: AIO (All-In-One) is the pipeline that runs all scanlation steps in sequence: Text Detection -> OCR -> Translation -> Bubble Cleaning -> Typography. Each step can be configured individually.

steps.title: Step Configuration
steps.content: In the AIO panel, each step has an on/off toggle. Disable steps you don't need - for example, if translations are ready, turn off Translation and OCR.
steps.tip: The step order is fixed and optimized. You cannot reorder them, but you can skip any step.

steps.title: Included Presets
steps.content: KOMA comes with optimized presets: "Manga JP->EN" (Japanese to English, manga fonts), "Manhwa KR->EN" (Korean, webtoon fonts), "Manhua CN->EN" (Simplified Chinese).

steps.title: Creating Custom Presets
steps.content: Configure each step as desired, then click "Save Preset". Give it a descriptive name and it will be available for future use.

entries.title: Manual Step-by-Step Workflow
entries.subtitle: Full control over each stage of the process.

steps.title: 1. Text Detection
steps.content: Switch to "Detect" mode and run detection. Review detected bubbles - adjust boxes manually by clicking and dragging corners.

steps.title: 2. OCR and Translation
steps.content: With text detected, switch to "Translate" mode. OCR extracts text from each bubble and the translator generates the localized version.

steps.title: 3. Cleaning
steps.content: In "Clean" mode, AI removes original text from bubbles. Review areas with complex art behind text - use the manual eraser for corrections.
steps.warning: Bubbles with text over detailed illustrations may require manual redraw (RD).

steps.title: 4. Typography (Typesetting)
steps.content: In "Type" mode, translated text is applied automatically to clean bubbles. Adjust font, size, alignment, and position as needed.

entries.title: Translator Fundamentals
entries.subtitle: How to use the KŌMA translation module.

steps.title: Select Language Pair
steps.content: In the translation panel, select source and target languages. KOMA supports: Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

steps.title: Choose Translation Engine
steps.content: Available options: GPT-4o (best quality), Google Translate (free, fast), DeepL (excellent for European pairs), and Local Models (Ollama).
steps.tip: For JP->EN, GPT-4o produces the best results with manga context. Use Google Translate as a cost-effective fallback.

steps.title: Text Panel
steps.content: Each detected bubble appears as a card in the right sidebar with: original text, translated text (editable), and detection confidence (%).

steps.title: Inline Editing
steps.content: Click any translated text to edit directly. Use Ctrl+Enter to confirm and move to the next bubble.

steps.title: Re-translate Individual
steps.content: Click the refresh icon next to any translation to generate a new version of just that bubble.

entries.title: Typography for Manga
entries.subtitle: Best practices for fonts, size, and style.

steps.title: Fonts for Regular Dialogue
steps.content: Use fonts like CC Wild Words, Anime Ace, or Manga Temple for normal dialogue. These fonts have good legibility at small sizes and convey the manga feel.
steps.tip: Avoid Comic Sans. Use Wild Words or Anime Ace for an authentic look.

steps.title: Fonts for Thoughts and Narration
steps.content: Use italic or light-serif fonts like CC Comicrazy Italic or Manga Temple Italic for internal thoughts. For narration, fonts like CC Meanwhile work well.

steps.title: Fonts for Screams and Emphasis
steps.content: For screams, use bold impactful fonts like Badaboom BB, CC Astro City, or anime-style display fonts. Increase size 20-30% over normal dialogue.

steps.title: Size and Spacing
steps.content: Default size is calculated automatically based on bubble area. Adjust manually if needed. KOMA uses optimized anti-aliasing for screens.

steps.title: Alignment and Line Breaks
steps.content: Text is centered by default in bubbles. For narrative boxes, left-align. Adjust line breaks to avoid rivers (unwanted vertical spaces).

steps.title: How It Works
steps.content: The AI model analyzes the detected text mask and reconstructs the missing background using inpainting. The result is a clean bubble ready for text.

steps.title: Adjusting the Mask
steps.content: If detection did not cover all text, use the manual mask tool to expand the area. Paint over remaining text with the mask brush.
steps.tip: Increase brush size (shortcut: ] to increase, [ to decrease) to cover larger areas quickly.

steps.title: When to Redraw
steps.content: Manual redraw is needed when: text is over detailed illustrations, sound effects (SFX) integrated into art, or irregular bubble borders that AI could not reconstruct well.

steps.title: Redraw Tools
steps.content: Use the clone brush (S) to copy nearby textures, the healing brush (H) for automatic blending, or import patches from Photoshop if needed.

steps.title: Check Translations
steps.content: Compare translated text with original. Check: semantic accuracy, natural flow, term consistency (character names, techniques, etc.), and register appropriateness (formal vs. informal).

steps.title: Check Typography
steps.content: Verify: text does not exceed bubbles, fonts are consistent throughout the chapter, SFX are translated when applicable, and no typos.

steps.title: Check Cleaning
steps.content: Look for: original text residue, inpainting artifacts, damaged bubble borders, and blurry fonts or incorrect aliasing.

entries.title: Setting Up AI Models
entries.subtitle: Installation and setup of local and cloud models.

steps.title: OpenAI (GPT-4o)
steps.content: Go to Settings -> AI Providers -> OpenAI. Enter your API Key. GPT-4o is used for high-quality translation with context.
steps.tip: Use the "prompt caching" option to reduce costs on large batches.

steps.title: Google Gemini
steps.content: Configure in Settings -> AI Providers -> Google. Gemini Pro offers excellent cost-benefit for batch translation.

steps.title: Ollama (Local LLMs)
steps.content: Install Ollama on your system and download models like Qwen2.5, Llama 3, or Mistral. In KOMA, configure the endpoint at Settings -> AI Providers -> Ollama -> URL (default: localhost:11434).

steps.title: Detection Models
steps.content: KOMA uses specialized models for manga text detection. Go to Settings -> Models -> Download to get the required models (manga-text-detector, bubble-segmenter).
steps.warning: Detection models require a GPU with at least 4GB VRAM for good performance.

steps.title: Page Navigation
steps.content: Left/Right or A/D - Previous/next page. Home/End - First/last page. Ctrl+G - Go to specific page number.

steps.title: Zoom and Viewport
steps.content: Ctrl+0 - Fit to screen. Ctrl++ / Ctrl+- - Zoom in/out. Ctrl+Scroll - Smooth zoom. Space+Drag - Pan image.

steps.title: Operation Modes
steps.content: 1 - AIO Mode. 2 - Translator Mode. 3 - Cleaner Mode. 4 - Typesetter Mode. 5 - Review Mode. Tab - Toggle original/processed.

steps.title: Quick Actions
steps.content: Ctrl+S - Save progress. Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y - Undo/Redo. Ctrl+Shift+Enter - Process all (AIO). Ctrl+E - Export. Escape - Cancel current operation.

steps.title: Configuring Batch
steps.content: Drag multiple folders (each representing a chapter) into KOMA. In AIO mode, enable "Batch Mode" in the controls panel. The system will process each chapter sequentially.

steps.title: Per-Chapter Presets
steps.content: You can assign different presets to each chapter in the queue. Useful when different series use different configurations.
steps.tip: For long series with the same style, apply the same preset to all chapters for consistency.

steps.title: Monitoring
steps.content: The progress bar shows the current step, current chapter, and estimated remaining time. Detailed logs are available at Settings -> Logs.

entries.title: Common Problems
entries.subtitle: Solutions for the most frequent errors.

steps.title: Text Not Detected
steps.content: If text was not detected: 1) Check that the image has a minimum resolution of 720px width. 2) Confirm the detection model is installed. 3) Try a lower threshold at Settings -> Detection -> Confidence Threshold.

steps.title: False Positives in Detection
steps.content: Areas like patterns, textures, or page numbers can be falsely detected as text. Use manual edit mode to delete unwanted boxes (select and press Delete).

steps.title: Invalid or Expired API Key
steps.content: Go to Settings -> AI Providers and check: 1) The key is correct (no extra spaces). 2) The key has not expired. 3) There are credits/quota available on your provider account.

steps.title: Incomplete or Truncated Translation
steps.content: This can happen due to timeout. Increase the timeout at Settings -> Advanced -> API Timeout. For long texts, try splitting into smaller segments.

steps.title: Slow Processing
steps.content: Check: 1) GPU is being used (Settings -> System -> GPU Status). 2) Images are not excessively large (>4000px). 3) Available RAM (minimum 8GB recommended).
steps.tip: Close other heavy applications during processing. KOMA uses GPU for AI model inference.

steps.title: Crash or Freeze
steps.content: Restart KOMA and try again. If it persists: 1) Clear cache at Settings -> Advanced -> Clear Cache. 2) Update to the latest version. 3) Send logs (Help -> Report Bug).
steps.warning: Save your progress frequently (Ctrl+S) to avoid losing work.
